# Facerizer

> Facerizer is an AI grooming and style coach. Users upload a clear photo and receive their face shape, a description of visible facial features, hairstyle, beard, glasses and general skincare recommendations, and a step-by-step appearance-improvement plan.

Facerizer is not a beauty rating and does not give medical advice. Its "AI Appearance Analysis Score" is a subjective estimate based on visible characteristics in one photo. It is for adults aged 18 and over.

## Key facts
- What it does: face shape detection, visible feature analysis, hairstyle/beard/glasses recommendations, improvement plans
- Who it is for: adults 18+, India-first, available worldwide
- Pricing: 1 free analysis (face shape, top strengths, 2 hairstyle, 2 glasses and 2 grooming picks); Pro from INR 399 per month (GST inclusive, subject to change)
- Privacy: photos are private, never sold or shared, not used for AI training without opt-in, and can be deleted at any time
- What it does not do: judge attractiveness or worth, infer personality, ethnicity, health or any sensitive trait from a face, or diagnose skin conditions
